title: Migrate Decision from TypedDict to dataclass
description:
Replace `Decision` in `schemas/game_export_types.py` with a dataclass after the decision support leaf records are already migrated.

This PR should cover the direct `Decision` construction and consumption paths in extraction, rendering, annotation, blunder analysis, and related helpers. Keep `Action`, event types, and root export containers out of scope so the review stays focused.

This is expected to be one of the higher-churn migrations; the PR should stay centered on `Decision` and its immediate call sites only.
